saints.name: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.title: Memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.shortBlurb: The memorial of Mary's dedication to God in the Temple as a young girl, all her life consecrated to the Lord…
biography: This memorial commemorates the presentation of the child Mary in the Temple of Jerusalem, where, by ancient tradition, she was offered to God and consecrated to his service. The account is drawn not from the canonical Gospels but from early Christian tradition, especially the Protoevangelium of James.

The feast arose in the Christian East and was gradually received into the Western calendar. Its meaning is less a single historical scene than the whole truth it expresses: that Mary was wholly given to God from her earliest years, the living temple prepared for the coming of the Lord.
saints.knownFor: Mary's consecration to God from her childhood.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “Feast of the Presentation of Mary”
